RemediationStrings.Title: The required app registration was not found.
RemediationStrings.Description: Install or repair Contoso Secure Client through your organization's approved process. Contact support if it is already installed.

RemediationStrings.Title: The BitLocker startup PIN baseline is not met.
RemediationStrings.Description: Contact support to check encryption, protection status, and startup protectors. Do not remove protectors or share your recovery key.
